items.title: Ellis Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: When I saw him in the theater, he say, “At least he got the movie made.”

ctx.x: Of course. I remember – what’s his name? I saw him in the movie.

No, I didn’t see him in the film itself. This guy, he’s a critic. He either is or was. I don’t know if he might have passed. When I saw him in the theater, he say, “At least he got the movie made.” It’s some more of that bottom line stuff.
